title: Add 'update' subcommand to skills-deploy for refreshing vendored skills
description:
skills-deploy fetch records url+commit in SOURCES.toml but has no way to pull upstream updates for an already-vendored skill. A natural complement:

  ./deploy/skills-deploy update <name>   # re-fetch latest, update commit pin in SOURCES.toml

Implementation: read existing SOURCES.toml entry for url, git clone --depth 1, diff against current vendor/<name>/, rsync if changed, update commit pin. Low priority — vendored skills don't change often, and manual re-fetch works in the meantime.

title: Verify provenance for vendored skills with UNKNOWN source
description:
Five vendored skills were gathered as-is because their upstream repos were uncertain. They are marked UNKNOWN in SOURCES.toml and need their real upstream identified, then re-fetched via 'skills-deploy fetch' so SOURCES.toml records the correct url + commit.

Skills to verify:
- article-extractor (third-party.md said 'PAI/skillfish community' — generic Readability wrapper)
- tapestry (third-party.md said 'PAI community (possibly)' — orchestrates youtube-transcript + article-extractor + ship-learn-next)
- logseq-markdown (third-party.md said jluo41/tools, but that repo has no skill by that name — provenance was stale/wrong)
- total-recall (contextify.sh commercial product; skill is a thin wrapper pointing at https://contextify.sh)
- use-railway (has railway scripts, no confirmed public upstream repo)

For each: find the real upstream, run './deploy/skills-deploy fetch <owner/repo>', verify the fetched SKILL.md matches the gathered one, then remove the old unverified copy from vendor/. Update SOURCES.toml so no UNKNOWN entries remain.
